interface.description: WireGuard interface configuration (the local side of the tunnel)

addresses.description: List of IPv4 and/or IPv6 addresses assigned to this WireGuard interface (e.g., '10.0.0.1/24')

listen_port.description: UDP port on which this interface listens for incoming connections (1–65535)

private_key.description: Base64-encoded 256-bit private key (generated via wg genkey); must be unique and secret

preshared_key.description: Optional base64-encoded per-interface pre-shared key for additional encryption (wg genpsk)

mtu.description: Override default MTU (leave empty or 0 to auto-detect; typical values: 1420)

save_config.description: If true, persist peer changes (e.g., from allowed IPs updates) back to config file on shutdown

post_up.default: iptables -A FORWARD -i %i -j ACCEPT; iptables -A FORWARD -o %i -j ACCEPT; iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
post_up.description: Shell commands to run after interface is brought up (supports %i for interface name)

post_down.default: iptables -D FORWARD -i %i -j ACCEPT; iptables -D FORWARD -o %i -j ACCEPT; iptables -t nat -D POSTROUTING -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
post_down.description: Shell commands to run after interface is brought down

dns.description: List of DNS servers to configure (via resolvconf or systemd-resolved) when interface is up

peers.description: List of WireGuard peer configurations (remote endpoints)

public_key.description: Base64-encoded 256-bit public key of the peer

allowed_ips.description: CIDR blocks this peer is allowed to send/receive traffic for

endpoint.description: Host:port of the peer (e.g., 'vpn.example.com:51820'); omit for dynamic clients (e.g., mobile)

preshared_key.description: Optional per-peer pre-shared key (base64); overrides interface-level if present

persistent_keepalive.description: Seconds between keepalive packets (0 = disabled; useful for NAT traversal)
